result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_predecessors()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get direct predecessors of a node (incoming neighbors). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5087-L5135){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_predecessors(node) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns nodes that have outgoing edges to the specified node. Only available for directed graphs. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Node ID or label to find predecessors for. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of predecessor node IDs (nodes with edges pointing to `node=`). ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is undirected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#3047706a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_node("A") graph.add_node("B") graph.add_node("C") graph.add_edge("A", "C") graph.add_edge("B", "C") c_id = graph.get_id_from_label("C") # Find nodes with edges pointing to C; returns node IDs predecessors = graph.get_predecessors(c_id) # Convert to labels: ['A', 'B'] labels = [graph.get_label_from_id(nid) for nid in predecessors] # Returns ['A', 'B'] labels ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['A', 'B'] ``` ::: :::
